use: The camp, on tour in the cold weather
subject: A wide view from inside a District Officer's ridge tent on cold-weather tour, looking out through the wide-open flaps. A folding camp table runs across the lower third of the frame and its top is completely BARE. A canvas chair, a tin trunk, a hurricane lantern, a folding washstand, a rolled bedding valise. Beyond the flaps, low golden morning sun across open country: a village of flat-roofed mud houses, a well with a bullock, ploughed fields in bands to the horizon, tethered horses, the blue smoke of a cook fire, and a line of trees along a watercourse.
